command: ls /repo/setup.py /repo/setup.cfg /repo/requirements-dev.txt /repo/pyproject.toml 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; cat /repo/setup.py; echo "==="; cat /repo/setup.cfg; echo "==="; cat /repo/requirements-dev.txt

cat /repo/logs/run_pytest_results.json | python3 -c "import json,sys; data=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f'Total: {data[\"summary\"][\"total\"]}, Passed: {data[\"summary\"][\"passed\"]}, Failed: {data[\"summary\"][\"failed\"]}, Errors: {data[\"summary\"][\"errors\"]}'); [print(f'{t[\"type\"]}: {t[\"file\"]}::{t[\"name\"]}') for t in data['tests'] if t['status']!='PASSED']" 2>/dev/null | head -80

python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/repo/logs/run_pytest_results.json')); print('Total:', d['summary']['total'], 'Passed:', d['summary']['passed'], 'Failed:', d['summary']['failed'], 'Errors:', d['summary']['errors'])"
python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/repo/logs/run_pytest_results.json')); print(json.dumps(d['summary'], indent=2)); print('---'); print(json.dumps(d['error_breakdown'], indent=2))"
python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/repo/logs/run_pytest_results.json')); print('Error tests:'); [print(t['file'], '::', t['name'], '-', t['type']) for t in d.get('error_tests', [])]"

python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/repo/logs/run_pytest_results.json')); print('Failed tests sample:'); print(json.dumps(d['failed_tests'][0], indent=2) if d['failed_tests'] else 'none'); print('---'); print('Error tests sample:'); print(json.dumps(d['error_tests'][0], indent=2) if d['error_tests'] else 'none')"

python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/repo/logs/run_pytest_results.json')); [print(t['test_id'], ':', t['error_type'], '-', t['error_message'][:200]) for t in d['failed_tests'] if 'error_handler' in t['test_id']]"
